checks: Profile schema normalization, read-only details, independent saves, linked validation/focus, failed-save retention and pending duplicate protection.
Password validation/focus, wrong-password and invalid-response states, unchanged payload, pending duplicates and secret-field clearing on confirmed success.
Address manual disclosure causes no lookup; zero coordinates remain valid canonical values; saved-card focus and durable success feedback.
Dirty address Cancel supports Keep editing/Discard without saving and restores action focus.
Verification failure/manual alternative, explicit retry, cancelled stale response, pending save guard, persistent location/expiry status and rejected-save retention.
Existing manual/expired addresses, shared-service warning, coordinate errors and named removal rejection/success preserve boundaries and focus.
Address permission gate hides write controls.
Actual service-card pointer trigger, guest booking sign-in gate and intentional close-focus restoration.
Availability loading, empty and error/retry states remain actionable and never create a booking.
Calendar arrow/Enter navigation and timezone changes retain canonical slot selection with an explicit appointment timezone.
Booking participant errors, Back retention, safe rejected/denied feedback, slot-conflict recovery, pending duplicate/Escape guards, request-specific confirmation and unchanged payload.
Instant bookings show confirmation only after server success.
en/lv/ru and breakpoint edges: profile/address and booking review reflow; live language switching retains edits.
Rendered screenshots reviewed separately; dark/reduced-motion mode, keyboard containment/Escape and 200% text at 320px.
limitations: Physical devices, real virtual keyboards, screen readers and actual 400% browser zoom are outside this runner.
No connected APIs, sessions, database writes, real geocoding or payment collection.
